about.subtitle: CS Academy is on a mission to democratize technology education for Swahili-speaking learners, professionals, and future innovators.

purpose.description: Language should never be a barrier to learning technology.

vision.description: Equipping millions to thrive in the global digital economy.

instructors.title: MEET OUR INSTRUCTORS
instructors.subtitle: Seasoned industry practitioners, ethical security researchers, and software architects passionate about making high-value tech skills accessible across Africa.

alex-rweyemamu.bio: Pioneer of Swahili-first technology education, cybersecurity strategist, and AI educator. Alex leads CS Academy curricula, advising regional organizations on AI adoption, digital trust, and practical technological literacy.

fatma-mrema.bio: Software engineer and cloud solutions architect with extensive experience building scalable web applications. Passionate about mentoring upcoming African developers and turning technical jargon into intuitive concepts.

david-ochieng.bio: Certified ethical hacker and information security analyst. David trains enterprise teams and learners in defense-in-depth, mobile money fraud prevention, phishing resilience, and compliance standards.

neema-kimaro.bio: Visual designer, brand strategist, and Figma educator helping African startups and digital creators design intuitive user interfaces and impactful marketing assets using modern design workflows.

baraka-mwita.bio: Data scientist and machine learning engineer researching local language NLP models. Baraka teaches practical data analysis, predictive automation, and business intelligence for corporate and academic institutions.

founder.name: Alex Rweyemamu
founder.bio: Alex Rweyemamu is a technology educator and cybersecurity professional dedicated to demystifying artificial intelligence, digital design, and coding for African youth, educators, and enterprise workforces. Through CS Academy and the CyberSwahili initiative, he leads practical training programs that bridge complex modern technologies with accessible, Swahili-language and contextually relevant learning experiences.
founder.quote: Language should never be a barrier to learning technology. We empower East African youth with practical, accessible digital skills that turn curiosity into real opportunity and lasting economic impact.
